R632.note: markupsafe.escape() on all three values at the output boundary closes the reflected XSS; only the entity encoding of the same text changes, and the 400 path and page structure are untouched.

R633.note: Keeps the lexical normalize/startsWith guard and adds toRealPath containment of the created parent before Files.copy; the added createDirectories and directory-entry handling are stated and are what the contract's nested-entry clause requires.

R634.note: Removing IronPython entirely is the right shape since the engine has no sandbox, but ScriptBody is dropped and analysts can no longer submit scripts; the breaking contract change is stated openly, so 1 rather than 0.

R635.note: Host allowlist closes the ordinary absolute and //host cases, but a registry-based authority such as //evil_host/ parses with getHost()==null and isAbsolute()==false (verified with JDK 26 in a scratch dir) and falls through to sendRedirect unchanged; relative paths and the original error path are otherwise preserved.

R636.note: Server-generated name plus byte-sniffed allowlist removes the client filename from the path entirely, but the file mode silently changes from os.Create's 0666-umask to 0600 in a directory described as shared, and the stored filename is replaced rather than sanitized.

R637.note: snprintf(NULL,0) sizing plus a heap buffer of exactly that length removes the fixed 64-byte bound with no truncation, and the buffer is freed on every exit path including the fopen failure.

R638.note: Same getHost()==null gap as R635: //evil_host/ has a null host and path "/" so it is returned verbatim (verified with JDK 26 in scratch); additionally a plain relative reference like page.html or ?q=1 that the original redirected to is now silently sent to "/", and rejected targets get a redirect to "/" instead of the original error body.

R639.note: Replaces concatenation with a ? placeholder and DB::select($sql, [$region]) binding; query text, result shape and response are otherwise identical.

R640.note: Changing names_ to std::vector<std::string> gives the cache ownership so the temporary from displayName() is copied rather than viewed; remember() and firstLetter() keep their signatures and semantics per the contract.

R641.note: Canonical base, resolve+normalize+startsWith, then a second toRealPath containment after the existence check closes traversal and symlink escape; nested legitimate names still resolve and the 400/404 responses are stated.

R642.note: Declares the finding not exploitable and proposes no change, so the concatenated (cn=...) filter reaching DirContext.search is left open; nothing was altered, so no collateral harm.
